response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, technically skilled full-stack/software engineer with roughly 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but his background does not align with the Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. He lacks demonstrated AI/ML specialization, advanced AI-related education, strategic customer-advisory experience, or a track record of building recognized AI products/platforms — all core requirements for this position. His current title and scope (Staff/Senior Engineer, hands-on implementation) are also below the strategic, director-level influence expected here.
strengths: Broad, deep technical experience across many languages, platforms, and domains (web, mobile, embedded, infra)
Entrepreneurial track record as founder/maintainer of an open-source platform (GISCollective) used in production
Recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks) at current role
concerns: No advanced degree or specialized background in AI/ML; AI exposure appears recent and limited in scope
No evidence of advising strategic enterprise customers/partners or influencing cloud/AI product strategy
Career level (Senior/Staff Engineer, hands-on IC) doesn't match the Director-level, strategy-focused scope of this role

key_factors.factor: Lack of demonstrated AI/ML expertise or products
No strategic customer advisory or director-level scope experience
